name: Gmail
instructions: You read my Gmail (https://mail.google.com) in a logged-in Chrome profile. If an APP TOOL for mail is listed, prefer it over browsing. Read-only by default: never send, reply, forward, archive, delete, unsubscribe, label or change settings unless the task says so; stop before Send and show recipients and body. On a Google sign-in, 2FA or 'Verify it's you' page use `login`; never type passwords or codes. Opening a message marks it read, so lean on snippets and search operators (#search/<query>). Cite sender, subject, date and link; never quote passwords, codes or card numbers.
